description: This file contains code for parsing 'TalkDirective' objects from JSON-like text input, including data classes for directives and parse results, as well as a parser object with utility functions for extracting values from JSON.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing a directive with various optional configuration parameters for voice synthesis or processing.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of parsing a text input into a TalkDirective, including the stripped text and any unknown keys.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse a text string and extract a TalkDirective object, returning a parse result with unknown keys and stripped text.
